滅.meaning: A grumpy little <part>fire</part> builds a <part>barricade</part> of logs around itself and dares the world to come in. A cloud just shrugs and lets fall <part>water drops</part>, plink, plink, until logs and flames are a soggy black puddle. One cloud is enough to <kanji>destroy</kanji> it.
滅.on: The <sound>me</sound>ssy smoke drifts up the cloud's nose: '<sound>Tsu</sound>!'
滅.kun: All that's left is one <sound>ho</sound>t <sound>ro</sound>ck, hissing in the puddle.

遊.meaning: On a rainy day, a <part>child</part> turns the living room into a pirate ship: a bedsheet <part>sail</part>, an ironing board for a <part>diving board</part>, and a sofa cushion <part>ramp</part> down into a sea of pillows. Dad wanders in and is made to walk the plank. Time to <kanji>play</kanji>.
遊.on: The ship's mascot is a toy <sound>u</sound>nicorn, always first down the ramp.
遊.kun: '<sound>Ah</sound>, a sea monster!' shouts the child, and throws a <sound>so</sound>ck at Dad.

条.meaning: A lawyer sits on a <part>folding chair</part> under a <part>tree</part>, writing the rules of the park: no juggling, no yodelling, no hugging squirrels. Each rule is nailed to the trunk with a big number on it. Every one is an <kanji>article</kanji>.
条.on: A little <sound>jo</sound>ey pops out of its mum's pouch and reads article one aloud.
条.kun: An <sound>e</sound>gg wobbles on a twig above his head, and a mother bird coos '<sound>Da</sound>rling, don't fall.'

象.meaning: A <part>pig</part> is tired of being small. It drapes a grey <part>wrap</part> over its back, stuffs a vacuum hose into its <part>mouth</part> for a trunk and tapes on just <part>one</part> floppy cabbage-leaf ear. At the zoo nobody blinks: it's an <kanji>elephant</kanji>, near enough.
象.on: Soon it has its own <sound>show</sound>, trumpeting through the hose twice a day.
象.kun: Then the zoo's <sound>ca</sound>rp, its <sound>ta</sound>co seller and its <sound>do</sound>ctor all dress up as elephants too, copying the pig.

印.meaning: A short postwoman tapes a rubber <part>stamp</part> to the end of a long <part>pole</part>, so she can reach the letterboxes on the twentieth floor. Thump, thump: every letter in the tower gets the same purple <kanji>stamp</kanji>, and so does one surprised window cleaner.
印.on: The purple comes from a whole bucket of <sound>in</sound>k slopped onto the pad.
印.kun: The window cleaner points at the purple mark on his bedding: '<sound>She</sound> <sound>ru</sound>ined my <sound>shee</sound>ts!'

厚.meaning: Under a <part>cliff</part>, a <part>child</part> is so worried about the <part>sun</part> that she puts on twelve coats, five scarves and a duvet. She looks like a walking mattress and can't bend her arms. Her layers are very <kanji>thick</kanji>.
厚.on: She still manages to lick an ice cream <sound>co</sound>ne through a gap in the scarves.
厚.kun: '<sound>Ah</sound>... <sound>tsu</sound>!' she sneezes, but under all that wool nobody hears a thing.

塁.meaning: On a frozen <part>rice field</part>, kids pile up <part>soil</part> and blocks of <part>ice</part> into little walls at all four corners. Each crew guards its own corner with a stack of snowballs and a very stern face. The field now has four <kanji>bases</kanji>.
塁.on: When spring comes, the ice melts and each fort sags into a muddy <sound>ru</sound>in.
塁.kun: On <sound>to</sound>p of the biggest fort, a <sound>ree</sound>d flag flutters over a <sound>de</sound>ckchair throne.
